description: Historical Freematics trip index, route, replay telemetry, diagnostics and every ECU-advertised standard PID for the selected trip.

links.title: Live vehicle view
links.tooltip: Open current link and fresh telemetry

links.title: Historical trips view
links.tooltip: Open the trip index and route evidence

links.title: Raw Freematics trip archive
links.tooltip: Open the collector's archived trip files

panels.description: Collector login time for the selected trip. Choose a trip above the dashboard.

targets.rawSql: SELECT start_capture_ms AS "Trip start" FROM trip WHERE trip_id = '$trip' AND device_id = '$device' LIMIT 1

panels.title: Trip start

panels.description: Collector-observed duration of the selected trip.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (end_capture_ms - start_capture_ms) / 1000.0 AS "Duration" FROM trip WHERE trip_id = '$trip' AND device_id = '$device' LIMIT 1

panels.title: Duration

panels.description: Distance is not materialised in the current SQLite contract; this value remains unavailable until the importer stores a lossless distance field.

targets.rawSql: SELECT NULL AS "Distance" FROM trip WHERE trip_id = '$trip' AND device_id = '$device' LIMIT 1

panels.title: Distance

panels.description: Time-average speed in miles per hour. OBD speed is preferred, with GPS as the fallback. OBD values older than 15 seconds are excluded.

targets.rawSql: SELECT AVG(m.numeric_value * 0.621371) AS "Average speed (mph)" FROM sample_metric AS m JOIN sample AS s USING (trip_id, sequence) WHERE m.trip_id = '$trip' AND m.pid = '0x10D' AND capture_utc_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER)

panels.title: Average speed

panels.description: Highest observed speed in miles per hour, with GPS used when OBD speed is unavailable. OBD values older than 15 seconds are excluded.

targets.rawSql: SELECT MAX(m.numeric_value * 0.621371) AS "Maximum speed (mph)" FROM sample_metric AS m JOIN sample AS s USING (trip_id, sequence) WHERE m.trip_id = '$trip' AND m.pid = '0x10D' AND capture_utc_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER)

panels.title: Maximum speed

panels.description: Highest engine RPM in the selected trip and time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT MAX(m.numeric_value) AS "Peak engine speed" FROM sample_metric AS m JOIN sample AS s USING (trip_id, sequence) WHERE m.trip_id = '$trip' AND m.pid = '0x10C' AND capture_utc_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER)

panels.title: Peak engine speed

panels.description: Estimated first fuel-level value from the final sample and gauge delta over the selected range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT m.numeric_value AS "Fuel at start" FROM sample_metric AS m JOIN sample AS s USING (trip_id, sequence) WHERE m.trip_id = '$trip' AND m.pid = '0x12F' AND s.capture_utc_ms IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.sequence ASC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Fuel at start

panels.description: Latest fuel-level sample in the selected time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT m.numeric_value AS "Fuel at end" FROM sample_metric AS m JOIN sample AS s USING (trip_id, sequence) WHERE m.trip_id = '$trip' AND m.pid = '0x12F' AND s.capture_utc_ms IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.sequence DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Fuel at end

panels.description: Start minus end fuel-tank percentage. Sensor quantisation means short trips may show zero or noise.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (first.numeric_value - last.numeric_value) AS "Fuel level change" FROM (SELECT m.numeric_value FROM sample_metric AS m JOIN sample AS s USING (trip_id, sequence) WHERE m.trip_id = '$trip' AND m.pid = '0x12F' AND s.capture_utc_ms IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.sequence ASC LIMIT 1) AS first, (SELECT m.numeric_value FROM sample_metric AS m JOIN sample AS s USING (trip_id, sequence) WHERE m.trip_id = '$trip' AND m.pid = '0x12F' AND s.capture_utc_ms IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.sequence DESC LIMIT 1) AS last

panels.title: Fuel level change

panels.description: Acceleration is not materialised in the current SQLite contract; no value is inferred from speed.

targets.rawSql: SELECT NULL AS "Peak acceleration" FROM trip WHERE trip_id = '$trip' AND device_id = '$device' LIMIT 1

panels.title: Peak acceleration

panels.description: Braking is not materialised in the current SQLite contract; no value is inferred from speed.

targets.rawSql: SELECT NULL AS "Peak braking" FROM trip WHERE trip_id = '$trip' AND device_id = '$device' LIMIT 1

panels.title: Peak braking

panels.description: Maximum fresh engine coolant temperature exposed by the ECU. Values older than 15 seconds are excluded.

targets.rawSql: SELECT MAX(m.numeric_value) AS "Maximum coolant" FROM sample_metric AS m JOIN sample AS s USING (trip_id, sequence) WHERE m.trip_id = '$trip' AND m.pid = '0x105' AND capture_utc_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER)

panels.title: Maximum coolant

panels.description: One row per collector trip in the dashboard time range. Use the Trip selector for a detailed route and metric investigation.

targets.rawSql: SELECT trip_id AS "Trip", device_id AS "Vehicle", datetime(start_capture_ms / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS "Start", datetime(end_capture_ms / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS "End", timestamp_quality AS "Timestamp quality", sample_count AS "Samples", gap_count AS "Gaps", archive_path AS "Archive" FROM trip WHERE device_id = '$device' AND start_capture_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) ORDER BY start_capture_ms DESC

panels.title: Trip index

panels.description: GPS route for the selected trip and time range. No line is shown until a valid outdoor fix is received.

targets.rawSql: SELECT capture_utc_ms AS time, latitude AS "Latitude", longitude AS "Longitude", gps_speed_kph AS "Speed (km/h)", gps_heading_degrees AS "Heading", sequence AS "Sample", device_monotonic_ms AS "Device monotonic (ms)", collector_received_ms AS "Collector receipt (ms)", timestamp_quality AS "Timestamp quality" FROM sample WHERE trip_id = '$trip' AND latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL AND capture_utc_ms IS NOT NULL AND capture_utc_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) ORDER BY sequence

panels.title: Trip route

panels.description: UK display units: OBD and GPS speed are shown in mph; RPM uses the right axis. Gaps remain visible instead of being invented.

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.capture_utc_ms AS time, MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x10D' THEN m.numeric_value * 0.621371 END) AS "OBD speed (mph)", MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x10C' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Engine RPM", MAX(s.gps_speed_kph * 0.621371) AS "GPS speed (mph)" FROM sample AS s LEFT JOIN sample_metric AS m USING (trip_id, sequence) WHERE s.trip_id = '$trip' AND s.capture_utc_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) GROUP BY s.trip_id, s.sequence, s.capture_utc_ms ORDER BY time

panels.title: Road speed and engine speed

panels.description: The current SQLite contract does not persist MEMS acceleration. The chart remains visible to show that this evidence is unavailable, not zero.

targets.rawSql: SELECT capture_utc_ms AS time, NULL AS "Acceleration (g)" FROM sample WHERE trip_id = '$trip' AND capture_utc_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Acceleration by device axis

panels.description: Only PIDs advertised by the ECU appear. Missing accelerator or torque series means unsupported, not zero.

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.capture_utc_ms AS time, MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x104' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Engine load", MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x111' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Throttle" FROM sample AS s LEFT JOIN sample_metric AS m USING (trip_id, sequence) WHERE s.trip_id = '$trip' AND s.capture_utc_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) GROUP BY s.trip_id, s.sequence, s.capture_utc_ms ORDER BY time

panels.title: Engine load and driver demand

panels.description: Coolant, intake, oil, catalyst and ambient temperatures, plus the logger enclosure, when exposed.

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.capture_utc_ms AS time, MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x105' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Coolant", MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x10F' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Intake temperature" FROM sample AS s LEFT JOIN sample_metric AS m USING (trip_id, sequence) WHERE s.trip_id = '$trip' AND s.capture_utc_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) GROUP BY s.trip_id, s.sequence, s.capture_utc_ms ORDER BY time

panels.title: Thermal system

panels.description: Fuel gauge percentage and closed-loop trims stay on the primary axis. Equivalence ratio uses the right axis; fuel percentage is not a volume measurement.

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.capture_utc_ms AS time, MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x12F' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Fuel level", MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid IN ('0x106', '0x107') THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Fuel trim" FROM sample AS s LEFT JOIN sample_metric AS m USING (trip_id, sequence) WHERE s.trip_id = '$trip' AND s.capture_utc_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) GROUP BY s.trip_id, s.sequence, s.capture_utc_ms ORDER BY time

panels.title: Fuel level, trim and mixture

panels.description: Intake, fuel-rail, barometric and evaporative pressures with mass airflow on its own axis.

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.capture_utc_ms AS time, MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x110' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Mass airflow" FROM sample AS s LEFT JOIN sample_metric AS m USING (trip_id, sequence) WHERE s.trip_id = '$trip' AND s.capture_utc_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) GROUP BY s.trip_id, s.sequence, s.capture_utc_ms ORDER BY time

panels.title: Airflow and pressure

panels.description: Satellite count and HDOP explain route quality; altitude uses the right axis.

targets.rawSql: SELECT capture_utc_ms AS time, gps_satellites AS "Satellites", gps_hdop AS "HDOP", gps_speed_kph * 0.621371 AS "GPS speed (mph)" FROM sample WHERE trip_id = '$trip' AND capture_utc_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) ORDER BY time

panels.title: GPS quality

panels.description: Fuel rate is shown directly when standard PID 0x5E is reported. The MAF estimate is a transparent petrol-only fallback (14.7:1 AFR, 745 g/L) and is not calibrated consumption; fuel percentage alone cannot produce efficiency.

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.capture_utc_ms AS time, MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x15E' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "ECU fuel rate", MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x110' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Mass airflow" FROM sample AS s LEFT JOIN sample_metric AS m USING (trip_id, sequence) WHERE s.trip_id = '$trip' AND s.capture_utc_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) GROUP BY s.trip_id, s.sequence, s.capture_utc_ms ORDER BY time

panels.title: Fuel rate and economy

panels.description: Every standard Mode 01 PID the vehicle advertised, with friendly metadata from kierandrewett/obd. 'Latest fresh' is blank when an ECU value is older than 15 seconds. A missing row means the ECU did not advertise that PID; it is never shown as zero.

targets.rawSql: SELECT m.pid AS "PID", COUNT(m.numeric_value) AS "Samples", MIN(m.numeric_value) AS "Minimum", AVG(m.numeric_value) AS "Average", MAX(m.numeric_value) AS "Maximum" FROM sample_metric AS m JOIN sample AS s USING (trip_id, sequence) WHERE m.trip_id = '$trip' AND s.capture_utc_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) GROUP BY m.pid ORDER BY m.pid

panels.title: Every ECU metric exposed by this vehicle

panels.description: Ignition timing, oxygen-sensor voltage and commanded air-fuel equivalence. These values help to investigate combustion behaviour; they are not a direct emissions test.

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.capture_utc_ms AS time, MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x10E' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Timing advance", MAX(CASE WHEN m.pid = '0x144' THEN m.numeric_value END) AS "Equivalence ratio" FROM sample AS s LEFT JOIN sample_metric AS m USING (trip_id, sequence) WHERE s.trip_id = '$trip' AND s.capture_utc_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) GROUP BY s.trip_id, s.sequence, s.capture_utc_ms ORDER BY time

panels.title: Combustion and exhaust

panels.description: Useful ECU lifetime and service counters. They are direct ECU reports, not values calculated from the short current trip.

targets.rawSql: SELECT m.pid AS "PID", MAX(m.numeric_value) AS "Latest" FROM sample_metric AS m JOIN sample AS s USING (trip_id, sequence) WHERE m.trip_id = '$trip' AND s.capture_utc_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) GROUP BY m.pid ORDER BY m.pid

panels.title: ECU service and emissions counters

panels.description: Durable capture-time history from SQLite. This contract panel stays empty or unavailable until the freematics-history datasource and archive importer are provisioned; Prometheus cannot backfill expired samples.

targets.rawSql: SELECT trip_id AS "Trip", device_id AS "Vehicle", datetime(start_capture_ms / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS "Start", datetime(end_capture_ms / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS "End", sample_count AS "Samples", archive_path AS "Archive" FROM trip WHERE device_id = '$device' AND start_capture_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) AND ('$trip' = '$__all' OR trip_id = '$trip') ORDER BY start_capture_ms DESC

panels.title: Durable trip archive (SQLite)

panels.description: Capture evidence from the durable archive. Unknown capture timestamps remain NULL; collector receipt time and device monotonic time are shown separately. Gap count is computed from monotonic clock jumps over three seconds.

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.sequence AS "Sample", t.timestamp_quality AS "Trip timestamp quality", s.timestamp_quality AS "Sample timestamp quality", s.device_monotonic_ms AS "Device monotonic (ms)", s.capture_utc_ms AS "Capture UTC (ms)", s.collector_received_ms AS "Collector receipt (ms)", CASE WHEN s.capture_utc_ms IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE s.collector_received_ms - s.capture_utc_ms END AS "Receipt lag (ms)", t.gap_count AS "Trip gaps" FROM sample AS s JOIN trip AS t USING (trip_id) WHERE s.trip_id = '$trip' AND s.collector_received_ms BETWEEN CAST($__from AS INTEGER) AND CAST($__to AS INTEGER) ORDER BY s.sequence LIMIT 5000

panels.title: Capture evidence, timestamp quality and gaps
